name: delegate_looks_like_error_output
notes: Error-preview detector (delegate.c vs LIVE delegate_tool.py). Inputs avoid three documented divergences outside this class: LIVE checks truthiness of parsed["error"] while the port only rejects JSON-null (an empty-string error diverges); LIVE lowercases+strips status values while the port compares exactly (uppercase statuses diverge); LIVE requires "traceback " with trailing space while the port prefix-matches bare "traceback".
